main_text.l: quas
modo recensui, non potuisse ab alio
quam ab illo, mihi sic in intimis meis præsentissimo
& me movente, proficisci, in-
dubitate ipse ego quoad me (quod jam
mihi sufficit) certus sum. Similiter quando
oculos aperui, & Solem atque alia cum
meo, corpora percepi, tunc me ipsas res
corporeas percepisse vividis sensationibus, nisi
sponte insanire velim, in dubium quoque
nequeo revocare. At quando vivida Dei
affectione absente, aut clausis Soli oculis,
volui nisu quodam & contentione activa
in me revocare & veluti præsentes sistere
menti reseas (Deum, Solem,) alioqui
absentes, aut mihi repræsentare præterea
alias quasdam earum proprietates & affectiones;
tunc bene sensi, ideas istas Dei,
proprietatum ejus a mea ratione inquisitarum,
ideam Solis luminisve ejus absentis,
& si quæ illius proprietates, jam non res
ipsas ; sed rerum pictoras steriles & veluti
mortuas esse, quæ nec me vivide afficiunt,
illuminant, calefaciunt, nec rebus me fa-
ciunt potiri. Unde distinguo veritates in
veritates reales, hasque in spirituales, quibus
ipsis rebus spiritualibus afficimur ;
& corporeas, quibus tangimur ipsis rebus cor-
poreis; & in veritates pictas sive umbratiles,
quibus rerum ideis seu picturis tantum
gaudemus, sive picturæ sint de rebus spi-
ritualibus, sive de corporeis, hisque vel
imaginatione, vel ratione pura seu intellectione
depictis. Has maximi necessariique
momenti distinctiones an cæteri capiant, rescio;

page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off; the text ends mid-sentence at the bottom of this part. Some words in the first lines are faint: "quas" and "potuisse" read as printed with long s. The text is set so that the first line is clipped; the transcription follows the visible letters. Letters s are long s as printed; doubtful: "pictoras" (possibly "pictura"), "steriles" (sterile). Print appears to read "si" for "& si" at the start.
